newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends barely changed in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends barely changed in modest trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished little changed in moderate Saturday trade marked by last-minute U.S. dollar buying, but dealers expected the local currency to rise gradually next week.
The local unit ended at T$27.510, back from an intra-day high of T$27.503, against Friday's T$27.511 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$63 million in the shortened Saturday session.
The Taiwan dollar was firmer against its American counterpart through most of Saturday's session, reflecting strong demand for liquidity for the red-hot stock market.
"With the stock market sizzling, demand for the Taiwan dollar will remain strong," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Continued inflows of foreign equity funds for investment in the local stock market also would strengthen the Taiwan dollar rate, dealers said.
Dealers said they expected trading in a range of T$27.49-53 for next week.
